info.name: StreamButed - Current Auth Smoke Integration
info.description:
Smoke integration checks aligned with the current email verification registration flow.

This is the current Postman/Newman collection for local gateway smoke tests. It avoids flows that require manually reading a verification email code and focuses on deterministic health, public endpoints, auth boundaries, and negative checks.

item.name: Auth - Login Before Verification Is Rejected

exec: pm.test('error envelope status matches response', function () { pm.expect(json.statusCode).to.eql(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('error envelope has error code', function () { pm.expect(json.error || json.code).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('skipped because registration attempt is unavailable', function () { pm.expect(previousAttemptId || '').to.eql(''); });
pm.execution.setNextRequest('Auth - Refresh Without Cookie Is Rejected');
pm.test('new pending attempt is returned', function () { pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('pending'); });
pm.test('new code uses a different attempt id', function () { pm.expect(json.attemptId).to.not.eql(previousAttemptId); });

item.name: Auth - Replaced Attempt Is Rejected As Invalidated

exec: pm.test('skipped because resend did not produce replacedAttemptId', function () { pm.expect(replacedAttemptId || '').to.eql(''); });
pm.execution.setNextRequest('Auth - Refresh Without Cookie Is Rejected');
pm.test('error envelope has status 400', function () { pm.expect(json.statusCode).to.eql(400); });
pm.test('error envelope has error code', function () { pm.expect(json.error || json.code).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('replaced attempt reports invalidated status', function () { var message = String(json.message || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, ''); pm.expect(message).to.match(/(Verification code is no longer valid|codigo de verificacion.*no.*valid)/i); });
pm.test('skipped because activeAttemptId is unavailable', function () { pm.expect(activeAttemptId || '').to.eql(''); });
pm.execution.setNextRequest('Auth - Refresh Without Cookie Is Rejected');
pm.test('response body is empty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });
